tagline: 理光胶片单反相机，1992 年发布
description: 理光于1992年推出的胶片单反相机。配备38-90 mm / f4.5-f7.2,7 elements 7 groups.。快门速度1-1/400Sec.。使用Field of view frame, parallax correction marks, single AF mark, super macro parallax correction marks.。感光度ISO 64-3200. Compatible with the DX system. (Non-DX films are set to ISO 100.)。

specs.自拍: Built-in electronic type with LED indicator. Operating delay of approx. 10 sec.
specs.取景器: Albada type bright-frame zoom viewfinder, magnification: 0.64x (at telephoto) 0.35x (at wide-angle), Field of view: 90% (at telephoto), 77% (at wide-angle)
specs.胶片/画幅: Field of view frame, parallax correction marks, single AF mark, super macro parallax correction marks.
specs.曝光测光: Dual SPD photocell. Programmed automatic exposure adjustment with Automatic Backlight Control system.
specs.感光度: ISO 64-3200. Compatible with the DX system. (Non-DX films are set to ISO 100.)
specs.闪光灯: Electronic flash automatically activates in dim light and backlight. (up to approximately 10ft.)
specs.英文简介: The Ricoh RZ-900 is a 35mm compact auto focus camera with a built in electronic flash.
